Definition: as if feminine of a derivative of G3962; paternal descent, i.e. (concretely) a group of families or a whole race (nation):--family, kindred, lineage.
BiblicalUsage: Patria is a family, a lineage, a paternal descent. Joseph goes up from Nazareth to Bethlehem because he is of the house and lineage of David in Luke 2:4. God says to Abraham in Acts 3:25 that in his seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed, and Paul says in Ephesians 3:15 that of the Father the whole family in heaven and earth is named.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the family of God is named from the Father, and the lineage of David is the line the promise runs through. That is why I hold that belonging to His family is the only lineage that finally matters.
